'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Soledar]]
****[[Russia]]'s [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|defence ministry]] says that its [[Russian Armed Forces|forces]] have taken full control of [[Soledar]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]]. However, [[Ukraine]] denies the fall of the city and its [[Soledar Salt Mine|salt mines]], claiming that the battle was still ongoing. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-64263119 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Lithuania–Latvia pipeline explosion]]
**A large [[explosion]] occurs on the [[Lithuania–Latvia Interconnection]] [[List of main natural gas pipelines in Lithuania|natural gas pipeline]] in [[Pasvalys District Municipality]], [[Lithuania]]. [[Latvia]]n Defence Minster [[Artis Pabriks]] says that the cause of the explosion would be investigated and that [[sabotage]] "could not be ruled out".  [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-64267736 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/lithuania-latvia-gas-pipeline-hit-by-explosion-operator-says-2023-01-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Assassination of Shinzo Abe#Aftermath|Aftermath of the assassination of Shinzo Abe]]
**[[Prosecutor]]s in [[Japan]] [[criminal charge|charge]] the 42-year-old accused killer of former [[Prime Minister of Japan|prime minister]] [[Shinzo Abe]] with [[murder]]. Additional charges are expected after the man was found competent by [[psychiatrist]]s earlier this week. [https://www.asahi.com/sp/ajw/articles/14813434 (''The Asahi Shimbun'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/japan-prosecutors-indict-yamagami-murder-ex-prime-minister-abe-yomiuri-2023-01-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[New York investigations of The Trump Organization]]
**The [[New York County Courthouse]] issues the maximum allowable [[United States dollar|$]]1.6 million [[Fine (penalty)|fine]] on [[the Trump Organization]], former [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[Conglomerate (company)|conglomerate]], for [[tax fraud]], [[Civil conspiracy|conspiracy]], and falsifying business records. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230113-trump-organization-fined-1-6-mn-for-tax-fraud (AFP via France 24)]
*The [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] announces a ban on [[Disposable product|single-use plastic]] cutlery, plates, polystyrene cups, bowls, and balloon sticks in [[England]] beginning in October as part of an effort to reduce [[plastic pollution]]. The ban will apply to all retailers, takeaways, and food vendors. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-64253130 (BBC News)] 

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Czech presidential election]]
**[[Czechs]] head to the polls to elect their [[President of the Czech Republic|president]]. Incumbent [[Miloš Zeman]] is not eligible to run for re-election, as he is [[term limited]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2023/01/13/andrej-babis-faces-stiff-competition-in-czech-republic-presidential-election (Euronews)]
